title: Undo-redo editor
statementMd:
Simulate a text editor starting empty. `['type', s]` appends `s`, `['delete', n]` removes the last `n` characters (or all if fewer), `['undo']` reverts the last type/delete not yet undone, `['redo']` re-applies the last undone action (any new type/delete clears the redo history), and `['show']` records the current text. Return the recorded texts.

**Example:** `editor_ops([["type", "ab"], ["type", "c"], ["show"], ["undo"], ["show"…)` returns `["abc", "ab", "abc"]`.
